messages:
maria (infra): Ran a replay vs synthetic baseline this morning comparing streaming vs non-streaming for gptx-8k on p4d. Saw ~15-20% p95 regression on the streaming path.

raj (runtime): what changed on runtime? kernel selection? batching configs?

tasha (perf): looks like the kernel selector picked a different matmul kernel after the last merge (commit ab12c3). Flame chart looks like the hot loop expanded during KV reads. p95 jumped 210ms -> 255ms.

maria (infra): reproduction command I used: `./bench/replay --trace ~/replays/marketing_long.json --model gptx-8k --streaming=true --clients=50 --duration=600`

leo (bench-bot): run artifacts posted: https://ci.internal/bench/1767001234 (CSV + perf.html). Note: KV cache hit rate dropped from 92% -> 68% for streaming runs vs non-streaming.

raj (runtime): KV hit-rate drop + kernel swap smells like prefix segmentation causing cache thrash. Streaming chops responses into many small chunks which can create more KV entries. Chunk_size was 256 right?

tasha (perf): yes streaming chunking default = 256. When streaming we split the output tokens, creating more KV entries and more cache lookups. Quick profiling snippet: 
``
[hot] attention_block -> matmul_fast (selected kernel: knl_v2)
KVCache::read -> 24% CPU
readloop wait -> 80ms spikes
```

maria (infra): Also observed backpressure: client read loop queues up, producing head-of-line stalls. Non-streaming path forms fewer small batches and used knl_v1 (larger GEMM) with better overall throughput.

raj (runtime): proposed action: tweak kernel selector heuristics to prefer knl_v1 for shorter effective sequence lengths (e.g., < 16 chunks) and skip micro-batching for streaming when kv_hit_rate < 80%. I'll open a draft PR.

tasha (perf): please run a controlled compare where we force the kernel and chunking so only one variable changes. e.g. `env KERNEL_FORCE=knl_v1 STREAM_CHUNK=1024 ./bench/replay ...` — apples-to-apples.

leo (bench-bot): scheduled follow-up runs: 1767001250 (force knl_v1), 1767001260 (force knl_v2), 1767001270 (streaming with no-chunk). Will post diffs and normalized token/latency curves.

deploy-bot: noted canary tag candidate: canary/runtime/ab12c3 -> paused automatic rollout until perf signoff :eyes: 

maria (infra): next steps: 1) @raj PR for kernel heuristics, 2) bench runs with forced knobs from @leo, 3) investigate KV cache eviction/segmentation logic (esp. per-shard eviction). Assigning to @raj and @tasha. :thumbsup:

raj (runtime): on it, I'll push a draft and request warm-run artifacts before merge.

tasha (perf): I'll append deterministic trace seeds and add kv_prof counters and eviction metrics to the run output so we can correlate misses -> latency.

maria (infra): closing loop here — sync in #eng-runtime tomorrow 10:30am to review diffs and decide canary. Thanks everyone.
